leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the grid-column property to span elements across multiple columns
Implement the grid-row property to extend elements across several rows
Configure grid items with span notation to control their placement
Construct grid layouts by manipulating item spanning behavior
Integrate row and column spanning to create complex grid structures
Update existing grid layouts by adjusting span values
Initialize grid containers with specific tracks and span items accordingly
